svg.title: Resonance Quotients B - Mark Color
svg.desc: algebraCOEF: 3 echoes from scale 0.83 to 1.25; normal coefficient 1.45, tangent coefficient 0.8; 3 affine repetitions. Color is assigned after both spline passes, enumerating individual marks. Seeded starting-parameter randomization varies the native source before algebra; both color orders share the same sampled settings.
